resources.string: Something relevant, something brilliant. This is the default text for demo. Rewrite it, combining long and short words, or use as-is.
Wraps text to the drawing width without trying to improve its appearance.

Varies the drawing width (in whole sp, down to 60% of the area) to make line lengths as even as possible, judged by their standard deviation. The last line of every paragraph is allowed to stay short.
The deviation policy, as DeviationDrawingPolicy, but scoring every line — including the last lines of paragraphs.
Enlarges the font in 1sp steps, up to +50% of the original size, to fill the drawing area as much as possible without overflowing it.
Varies the drawing width so the line rectangles cover the largest share of the result\'s own bounding box, never going below 60% of the drawing area.
